Location: Spain
Description:

A rotational Second Engineer / ETO is sought for a 70m+ motor yacht based in Spain. The role involves a 10:10 rotation, with an initial 4-month maintenance period. Candidates should have previous experience on similar-sized vessels and be proficient with ETO tasks, ideally holding STCW III/2. Salary ranges from €6000 to €6500 DOE, with joining expected mid to end November. The vessel is primarily private with some charters.
